claims.statement: From 31 July 2026, covered manufacturers must repair qualifying products within a reasonable time and at a reasonable price, publish repair-service information, and expose indicative prices, creating a changed repair transaction workflow.
Consumers choose and fund repair or replacement, while repairers can fund acquisition from completed-job revenue; willingness to pay a concierge or commission at Polish ticket sizes is unknown.
A plausible control path is direct consumer intake and nonexclusive completion agreements with several repairers, but no consumer relationship or shop contract is secured.
The Commission plans a public European repair platform, currently foreseen to become operational in January 2028, creating both validation of discovery friction and a future substitute.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Structured remote intake, comparable all-in quotes, collection, and completion guarantees must add value beyond a free directory
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: No venture relationship exists; manufacturers, retailers, and repairers currently reach consumers directly
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Failure-intent search, retailer or insurer referral, landlord portfolio, and repairer inventory gaps

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Failure-intent search, retailer or landlord partner share, and repairer onboarding
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Consumer preauthorization with repairer settlement after completion; refunds and disputes create reserve needs
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Potentially thin on low-ticket repairs and strongly dependent on logistics density and dispute rate
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Quote normalization, parts matching, dispute handling, status chasing, and rework
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Consumer-law compliance, insurance, privacy, payment reconciliation, and quality governance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Target 10-18% completed-job commission plus 49-99 PLN optional diagnostic or collection fee
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Payments, pickup and return, customer support, refunds, fraud, and partner quality checks

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Manufacturers, retailers, classifieds, local directories, insurers, and the planned European repair platform can connect consumers to repairers
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A completed repair is the primary paid event; measurable loss is excess replacement spend, search time, failed diagnosis, repeat repair, or device downtime
commercial_mechanics.payer: Repairer through a completed-job commission and consumer through an optional fixed logistics or diagnostic fee
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Product failure outside or inside guarantee, an unattractive manufacturer quote, or desire to extend product life
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each future failure for consumers and continued monthly job flow for repairers

contrary_evidence: A Commission-run European repair platform is planned, so a pure directory has little durable value.
Manufacturers now have stronger incentives and obligations to publish repair offers directly.
Low-value appliances may still be economically irrational to collect and repair.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed nonexclusive repairer distribution agreement plus consumer service terms; none secured
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Provide a consumer-paid quote and collection concierge using replaceable shops without marketplace exclusivity
critical_control_point.current_owner: Consumer, manufacturer, retailer, and local repairers each control parts of the journey
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: No venture relationship exists; manufacturers, retailers, and repairers currently reach consumers directly
critical_control_point.duration: Unknown until partner and consumer terms are executed
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Public repair rules, published service information, and lawful outreach to consumers and repairers are available; no repair network or consumer demand is owned
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The consumer and participating repair businesses
critical_control_point.renewal: Repairer relationship proposed to renew annually; consumer transactions are episodic
critical_control_point.subject: Consumer repair request and quote-comparison relationship

economics.acquisition_route: Failure-intent search, retailers, insurers, landlords, repair shops, and local category pilots
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 8,000 monthly repairs at 60 PLN net revenue equals 5.76m PLN annual net revenue before overhead; marketplace value above 5m PLN requires dense repeatable supply and low disputes, none yet proven
economics.founder_time: One product category and one metro can fit 3-5 hours daily if couriers and repairs are outsourced
economics.gross_margin_basis: Commission and fees less acquisition, logistics subsidy, support, refunds, disputes, payments, and partner QA
economics.payback: Transaction-level payback must be immediate; repeat-customer CAC payback is uncertain because failures are episodic
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 10-18% completed-job commission plus 49-99 PLN optional collection or diagnostic fee
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repairer repeat can be high; consumer repeat is low-frequency but multi-category

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Model-symptom, quoted-price, parts, completion, repeat-failure, and turnaround data improve routing and quote confidence
fingerprint.customer: Polish consumers and small landlords with broken covered appliances, phones, tablets, or other repairable goods
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Search at the failure moment, retailer post-warranty referrals, landlord portfolios, insurers, and qualified repair shops
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Structured repair intake, parts and price comparison, pickup, status tracking, and payment marketplace
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Repairer pays a commission on a completed job while the consumer can pay a fixed collection or diagnostic fee
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A covered product fails and the owner must decide quickly between manufacturer repair, independent repair, and replacement

founder_fit: Routing, quote normalization, failure classification, and fraud detection fit data-science skills
A single category and city can be tested within the founder's time and capital constraints
Completed jobs, turnaround, first-time-fix rate, and repeat failures are measurable
Partner distribution and workflow automation can reduce reliance on founder-led public content
risks: Disputes over diagnosis, hidden damage, data loss, and repair quality
Pickup and return costs can exceed marketplace revenue
The public platform or retailers can commoditize matching
Handling personal devices creates privacy and custody exposure

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: commission marketplace for completed repairs with optional logistics
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: structured consumer intake and quote comparison at the failure moment
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: qualified repair shops with model coverage parts access and dependable turnaround

structure.commercial_archetype: Completed-repair marketplace with optional logistics fee
structure.control_point: The consumer relationship at structured diagnosis and quote comparison
structure.critical_dependency: Dense, trustworthy specialist repair labor with access to parts and manufacturer information

thesis: Observed transaction change: EU repair rules started applying on 31 July 2026, obliging covered manufacturers to offer repair on reasonable terms, publish repair-service information, and expose indicative prices for typical repairs. Build a Polish repair-request concierge that converts a photo, model number, and symptom into comparable offers, parts availability, collection, and a completed repair transaction before the planned European platform becomes operational.
title: Repair Quote and Parts Concierge
uncertainties: Polish transposition details, enforcement, and covered-product scope
Repairer willingness to quote remotely and pay commission
Ticket size, parts availability, repeat-failure rate, and logistics density by category
Consumer trust in prepaying through an intermediary
